name: Starburst
description: Atomic-age starbursts with long and short rays and a bead at the heart, scattered at every size and angle.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { --t: translate(@r(-20%, 20%), @r(-20%, 20%)) rotate(@r(0deg, 90deg)) scale(@r(.5, 1.2)); --s: @p(@var(--s12), @var(--s8)); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: @var(--s); clip-path: @var(--s); transform: @var(--t); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 41%; top: 41%; width: 18%; height: 18%; border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); transform: @var(--t); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
